text:
Ava: Final coordination thread for Monday webinar: registration page fields, Zoom recording layout, where to store assets, and post-event routing to HubSpot + SDRs.

Jon: Registration is on Typeform. Hidden fields set: `ga_clientId`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`. Do we need an explicit GDPR checkbox?

Sana: Yes add GDPR checkbox (opt-in for marketing) and a separate consent for recording reuse. Keep registration under 6 fields to avoid drop-off.

Diego: Zoom settings I changed: cloud recording ON, `recording_layout=gallery+active_speaker` so editors can choose. Enabled auto-transcript and SRT export. Passing recording to S3 after creation.

zoom-bot: Cloud recording live | Auto-transcript ON | SRT export enabled.

Ava: Post-event asset flow: Zoom cloud -> S3 (bucket: redwood-webinars) -> trigger AWS Lambda -> create clips via Descript API -> drop in Marketing/GDrive/Webinars/2026-03. Need naming convention: `YYYYMMDD_title_clip01.mp4`.

Jon: For HubSpot: webhook payload should include `webinar_id`, `email`, `attendance_duration_sec`, `questions_asked`, and hidden UTMs. Sample payload: 

``
{
  "webinar_id":"2026-03-22-llm-scale",
  "email":"{{email}}",
  "attendance_duration_sec":"{{watch_time_seconds}}",
  "questions_asked":"{{q_count}}",
  "utm_campaign":"{{utm_campaign}}"
}
``

Sana: Nice. Sales segmentation: attendees >= 25m => nurture sequence A (demo CTA). < 25m but asked >=1 Q => SDR outreach. Non-attendees => replay email only. Also tag registrants who selected "enterprise" on the form as high-touch.

Diego: Quick ask: can SDRs get a 30s highlight clip attached to the HubSpot contact timeline? Lambda can add GDrive link and `clip_preview` property.

hubspot-bot: Test webhook delivered successfully to HubSpot endpoint (200 OK).

Ava: Follow-up cadence proposal: Day0 (2-4h after): replay + slides + transcript + feedback form. Day2: short case study tailored by industry (automated via `industry` reg field). Day5: CTA to book a demo (Calendly link + 15% POC credit). A/B test subject lines on Day0: "Recording + slides: Serving LLMs at scale" vs "Missed it? Replay + highlights".

Jon: Calendar booking in follow-up: use Booker link with prefilled email from HubSpot. Must append UTM params: `?utm_source=webinar&utm_medium=email&utm_campaign=llm_march2026`.

Sana: Also add a short NPS-style poll in Day0 email: 1-5. Track responses into HubSpot property `webinar_nps`.

Diego: Rehearsal plan: 30m tech check (mics, share screen, recording) + 15m dry run with slides. I'll start the Zoom 45m early and run recording check.

Ava: Ownership: Jon = registration & tracking, Sana = follow-up copy + nurture, Diego = Zoom + recordings pipeline, Ava = overall event lead + A/B test. SLA: hot leads (>=30m or asked >1 question OR enterprise tag) get Slack alert to #sdr-live with contact link within 1 hour.

Jon: I'll create the Zapier flow example: POST to HubSpot with JSON and then a secondary step to send Slack message to #sdr-live when conditions met.

Sana: Copy notes for Day0 replay email (short, 3 bullets, 2 CTAs). I'll drop draft in the marketing / webinars doc in 20m.

Ava: Perfect. Reminder: enable "notify participants when recording starts" in Zoom and set recording retention to 365 days. I'll run a micro-rehearsal 15m before go-time. :rocket:
